benchmark: Submitted CSPG4 letter and first-round audit permit a useful RNA-level comparative disease observation with explicit limitations. No universal protein/functional-validation prerequisite is imposed.

prior_exposure: Mandatory prior-decision reuse displayed existing CSPG4 and R3/R8 historical RNA result summaries. No new processed matrix, gene output or phenotype values were read. New candidate selection must remain exploratory and cannot be presented as fully blind discovery.
necessary_question_specific_checks: The stated empirical question adds a useful unreported comparison beyond the cited primary conclusion, not solely a new cohort accession, annotation repair or a failed hypothesis invented here.

Actual native EMC pathology/source identity, all released assay conditions and appropriate control measurements are linked; generic labels, reference aliases and technical samples do not authenticate a new donor.
Units and processed assay mappings support the intended measurement. Missing filtered rows, old transcript-index gaps and unavailable values are not biological zeros.
Specimen mixture, chip/source/batch, handling, treatment and donor overlap are modeled as alternatives to the claim rather than ignored or used to preclude every descriptive comparison.
The candidate has a prospective measurement/statistic/uncertainty/disproof plan before new values. No new target list or threshold is selected after observing outcomes.
not_universal_requirements: Protein, functional response or clinical outcomes are not mandatory for a useful limited RNA contribution.
Cross-platform numerical pooling is not required and may be invalid; separate assay estimates and sensitivity checks can be useful.
A bounded source-gate failure does not establish all possible analyses exhausted.
current_status: Awaiting owner concrete proposals; zero viable proposals remains permissible. No independent alternative gene panel or new source search.
